plan: Add a Compose-first Paper Upload & Processing feature (upload via system file picker or DOI/arXiv URL, mock backend submit + status polling, a processing screen, and a profile 'My Papers' list) following the existing MVI + mock-use-case conventions, with simple state-based navigation reached from a Home upload FAB.
steps: Add data models: PaperStatus enum (QUEUED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED) and a Paper/PaperVideo model for the completed result shown in the profile feed.

Create domain mock use cases mirroring GetFeedUseCase (suspend operator invoke + injectable dispatcher): UploadPaperUseCase (accepts a PDF Uri or DOI/URL, returns a fake paperId after a short delay), PollPaperStatusUseCase (returns Flow<PaperStatus> emitting QUEUED/PROCESSING then COMPLETED using Flow + delay ~5s, simulating 30-120s), and GetMyPapersUseCase (returns hardcoded processed papers).

Create the upload feature package (com.example.myapplication.upload) with UploadUiState, UploadIntent (SelectTab, PickPdf, EnterDoi, SubmitFile, SubmitDoi, Retry), and UploadViewModel following the HomeViewModel pattern, modeling upload-progress, success (paperId), and error/retry state.

Build UploadScreen Compose UI: a tabbed layout (File tab + DOI tab) with testTags (fab_upload, tab_doi, input_doi, btn_submit); wire the file picker via rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.GetContent()) restricted to application/pdf; show a progress indicator during upload.

Build ProcessingScreen Compose UI with an animated placeholder, a processingScreen container tag and a processingMessage tag, observing the polled status; show an error message with a retry button on FAILED.
Add a ProfileScreen with a 'My Papers' section (myPapersList testTag) rendering processed video cards (videoCard testTag) sourced from GetMyPapersUseCase.

Introduce minimal state-based navigation in MainActivity (a sealed Screen state + when() switch, no new navigation dependency) wiring Home (with an upload FAB) -> Upload -> Processing -> Profile to match the acceptance-criteria flow.
Add unit tests under app/src/test for UploadViewModel and PollPaperStatusUseCase (status transitions, success path, failure + retry) using StandardTestDispatcher/runTest, mirroring HomeViewModelTest.

Add Compose instrumentation tests under app/src/androidTest using createAndroidComposeRule<MainActivity>() and onNodeWithTag (DOI submit -> processing screen; completed paper -> profile 'My Papers'), replacing the ticket's View-ID Espresso example since this is a Compose app.
Run ./gradlew :app:compileDebugSources and ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest to validate compilation and unit tests.
